title: Practice 1: Object clauses: что, чтобы, ли

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Isn't he a bit young?
exercises.why: **маловатый → маловато ли** — short form (neut.): -о. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Tom is unlikely to eat much.
exercises.why: **вряд ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.q: Спроси ее, не ___ (зашить + ли) она дыру в твоих джинсах.
exercises.prompt: Ask her if she'll sew up the hole in your jeans.
exercises.why: **зашить → зашьет ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Do we have to have our cat neutered?
exercises.why: **Нужно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (нужно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Столь резкая отповедь ___ (едва + ли) была обязательна.
exercises.prompt: Such a harsh rebuttal was hardly necessary.
exercises.why: **едва ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.prompt: Is there a treatment?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существует ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Can the coronavirus be cured?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Have you pray’d to-night, Desdemona?
exercises.why: **молиться → Молилась ли** — past tense, fem.: drop -ться, add -лась. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Не ___ (привести + ли) к проблемам кормление собаки чесноком?
exercises.prompt: Will feeding my dog garlic cause any problems?
exercises.why: **привести → приведёт ли** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли) микроорганизмы эволюционировать в закрытой системе?
exercises.prompt: Can microorganisms evolve in a closed system?
exercises.why: **мочь → Могут ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Can you eat the skin of a kiwi?
exercises.why: **Можно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (можно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (мочь + ли) я пользоваться полнотекстовым поиском на Линуксе?
exercises.prompt: Can I use full-text search on Linux?
exercises.why: **мочь → Могу ли** — present tense, 1st person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Зеленский, может, и клоун, но ___ (едва + ли) фашист.
exercises.prompt: Zelensky may well be a buffoon, but he is hardly fascist.
exercises.why: **едва ли** — a set phrase: «hardly, unlikely».

exercises.prompt: Does the supernatural exist?
exercises.why: **существовать → Существует ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Is eating pork a sin?
exercises.why: **Греховно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (греховно): a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: Are there any sentences that are absolutely untranslatable?
exercises.why: **бывать → Бывают ли** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (знать + ли) вы, что мужчины, регулярно принимающие противозачаточные таблетки, не беременеют?
exercises.prompt: Did you know that men who regularly take birth control pills don't get pregnant?
exercises.why: **знать → Знаете ли** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.prompt: I don't know if it's appropriate.
exercises.why: **уместно ли** — ли comes right after the word the question is about (уместно): a yes/no question.

exercises.q: ___ (есть + ли) его тётушка яблоко или банан?
exercises.prompt: Is his aunt eating an apple or a banana?
exercises.why: **есть → Ест ли** — present tense, 3rd person singular. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.

exercises.q: Похоже, вы пишете бездоказательную чепуху. Не ___ (хотеть + ли) включить прописные буквы?
exercises.prompt: It looks like you're writing unsubstantiated nonsense. Would you like to turn on all caps?
exercises.why: **хотеть → хотите ли** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ите belongs to the second (и) conjugation. The particle ли follows the verb: a yes/no question.
